name: 78232 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78232 (San Antonio) has 173 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78232 (San Antonio) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78232 (San Antonio) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 55 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
